messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Added **Game name** under **Reproduce a game**. Names now save and restore with progress.

Fixed pasted saves being rejected when JSON fields appear in a different order. Existing unnamed saves still work.

All 146 unit/static tests and 80 browser tests pass, along with type, build, and formatting checks.
